behaviors: All49 source lines reviewed. The original observer hashes public library projections for global plus live-session project roots every2seconds, deduplicates roots and emits only an empty library.changed refetch signal when the projection changes.

The owned watcher now samples redacted library.list outputs; actual tests prove external create/edit/delete, stable no-event floor, live root entry, stopped-root departure and joined shutdown.

Actual runtime wiring test observes an external write through a real Hub/Client subscription, reads the updated entry and shuts down before removing its config tree. Secret-only MCP credential changes leave the public projection hash unchanged.
A malformed project cwd is skipped without suppressing global or other valid project changes; negative projection-hash control pins this isolation.
intentionalChanges: Owned engine inventory uses the existing live snapshot map instead of redundant daemon HTTP reads and a process-global2second cwd cache. Catalog mode requests registered sessions.snapshots with a2second timeout; an unavailable/malformed inventory retains known roots while global changes remain observable.

Only local process-live rows contribute local paths; remote hub paths do not become local project selections. Roots are sorted/deduplicated and framed before hashing. Sampling failures retain the last good revision. Polling is joined on shutdown, including blocking sample completion.

Library reads now reuse the existing bounded regular-file reader to prevent post-stat growth/FIFO replacement from leaving the new polling owner with an unbounded read. No general atomic parent-replacement guarantee is claimed.
